## Research Profile

My research career began at **Prince of Songkla University (PSU), Phuket Campus**, where I completed graduate work in **Information Technology** and published peer-reviewed studies on **medical image mining**, **texture analysis**, and **machine learning for osteoarthritis (OA) detection** from knee X-ray imagery. That foundation in AI, computer vision, and clinical decision support now informs my work in **cybersecurity**, **quantum science**, and **applied data science** as a lecturer, lab manager, and consultant.

I hold an **M.S. and B.S. in Information Technology** (GPA **3.91**, ASEAN Hub Scholar, Prince Sirindhorn Scholar), served as **Data Science Lab Manager** and **Lecturer** at the **Institute of Technology of Cambodia (ITC)**, and continue professional development in **cybersecurity** (Per Scholas, CompTIA CySA+ pathway).

**Contact:** [sophalcamchan38@gmail.com](mailto:sophalcamchan38@gmail.com) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sophalchan)

## Research Interests

- **Medical image mining & computer vision** — texture descriptors, ROI analysis, OA grading from radiographs
- **Machine learning & deep learning** — SVM, ensemble methods, CNNs, feature selection (CFS)
- **Cybersecurity & AI-driven threat detection** — SIEM/SOAR, intrusion analytics, automated response
- **Quantum science & advanced computing** — quantum information fundamentals and optimization
- **Data science education** — capstone supervision, reproducible pipelines, deployment (Flask, Docker, Streamlit)

## Publications & Scholarly Output

::: {.publication-list}

### Journal Articles

#### 1. Image Texture Analysis for Medical Image Mining: A Comparative Study Direct to Osteoarthritis Classification using Knee X-ray Image

**Authors:** Sophal Chan, Kwankamon Dittakan, Matias Garcia-Constantino  
**Venue:** *International Journal on Advanced Science, Engineering and Information Technology* (IJASEIT), Vol. 10, No. 6, pp. 2189–2199, Dec. 2020  
**Role:** First author  
**Summary:** Compares ten texture descriptors across four knee ROIs (MF, LF, MT, LT) to classify OA vs. non-OA on 131 X-ray images. **Best result:** Lateral Femur (LF) with Local Binary Pattern — **AUC = 0.912**.  
**Link:** [View paper (IJASEIT)](https://ijaseit.insightsociety.org/index.php/ijaseit/article/view/8279)

#### 2. Osteoarthritis detection by applying quadtree analysis to human joint knee X-ray imagery

**Authors:** Sophal Chan, Kwankamon Dittakan, Subhieh El Salhi  
**Venue:** *International Journal of Computers and Applications*, Vol. 44, No. 6 (Taylor & Francis), 2020  
**DOI:** [10.1080/1206212X.2020.1838145](https://doi.org/10.1080/1206212X.2020.1838145)  
**Role:** First author  
**Summary:** Shape-based early OA detection using quadtree decomposition on knee X-rays; evaluates three ROI datasets on 128 participants (66 OA cases). **Best result:** Dataset 3 (Otsu knee joint space ROI), threshold 10 — **AUC = 0.917**.  
**Link:** [View paper (Taylor & Francis)](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/1206212X.2020.1838145?journalCode=tjca20)

### Conference Papers

#### 3. Osteoarthritis Stages Classification to Human Joint Imagery Using Texture Analysis: A Comparative Study on Ten Texture Descriptors

**Authors:** Sophal Chan, Kwankamon Dittakan *(corresponding author)*  
**Venue:** *Recent Trends in Image Processing and Pattern Recognition* (RTIP2R 2018), Communications in Computer and Information Science, vol. 1036, pp. 209–225, Springer Singapore, 2019  
**DOI:** [10.1007/978-981-13-9184-2_19](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-981-13-9184-2_19)  
**Published online:** 16 July 2019 · **956+ accesses · 4 citations** ([Springer](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-981-13-9184-2_19))  
**Role:** First author  
**Summary:** Classifies OA severity grades (0–4) via texture features and Correlation-based Feature Selection on 130 images. **Best result:** Medial Tibia (MT) ROI — **AUC = 0.871**.  
**Link:** [View paper (Springer)](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-981-13-9184-2_19)

### Theses

#### 4. Early Detection of Osteoarthritis Stage by Applying Classification Techniques to Human joint Imagery

**Author:** Sophal Chan  
**Degree:** Master of Science in Information Technology  
**Institution:** College of Computing, Prince of Songkla University, Phuket Campus  
**Summary:** Comprehensive thesis comparing **(i)** texture-based, **(ii)** graph-based, and **(iii)** CNN approaches for OA detection and multi-stage classification. Reports best texture-based **AUC = 0.912** (detection) and **0.871** (staging); graph-based detection **AUC = 0.917**; CNN detection **AUC = 0.880**.  
**Link:** [View thesis (PDF — PSU Knowledge Bank)](http://kb.psu.ac.th:8080/psukb/bitstream/2016/13400/1/435044.pdf)
